SELECT 
  rental_data.store_id,
  AVG(rental_data.rental_payment_total) AS avg_payment_total_per_rental,
  AVG(rental_data.rental_payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental
FROM (
  SELECT 
    i.store_id,
    r.rental_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_total,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS rental_payment_count
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  WHERE p.amount > 4.99
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
) AS rental_data
GROUP BY rental_data.store_id
ORDER BY rental_data.store_id
